ch30.note: The principal thoroughfare of Shanghai's French Concession (today's Huaihai Road), a fashionable avenue of shops, cafes, and White Russian émigré businesses.
A police sergeant, so named for the three chevron stripes of the rank—here one of the Chinese constables of the concession police.
The zhang (丈) is a unit of length of about 3.3 meters (ten Chinese feet), so 'two zhang' is a drop of some six or seven meters—the height Chen weighs against his legs before the leap.
